courses.name: Energize
courses.blurb: Batteries everywhere, and six beams that make you pay for them.

courses.name: Steps
courses.blurb: Green belts one space, blue belts two, and a pit where the slow lane ends.

courses.name: The Keep
courses.blurb: Two rings, one inside the other, turning opposite ways.

courses.name: Tempest
courses.blurb: Belts everywhere, six push panels, and three beams across the middle.

courses.name: In & Out
courses.blurb: All belt, no floor to speak of: twenty-nine green and fifty-two blue.

courses.name: Cactus
courses.blurb: Three push panels, two beams crossing in the middle, and five gears all turning left.

courses.name: Misdirection
courses.blurb: Nineteen gears, a roundabout in the middle, and a two-barrel laser down the bottom.

courses.name: The "O" Ring
courses.blurb: A ring of oil round six flamers, and eight push panels on the rim.

courses.name: Exchange
courses.blurb: Everything moves. The walls are the only place to stand.

courses.name: Island
courses.blurb: Two rings turning against each other, and a hole in the middle.

courses.name: Maelstrom
courses.blurb: Everything spirals inward, and the middle is a hole.

courses.name: Cannery Row
courses.blurb: Two belt lanes run the whole length of it, with a crusher on every other square.

courses.name: Board G
courses.blurb: Portals, flamethrowers and four spills of oil.

courses.name: Pit Maze
courses.blurb: Twenty-six holes and the belts that run between them.

courses.name: Board H
courses.blurb: Sixteen flamethrowers and a conveyor under half the rams.

courses.name: Cross
courses.blurb: Four belt lanes meet, and the junction is a hole.

courses.name: Crosscut
courses.blurb: Four belt lanes on one side, twenty-six holes on the other.

courses.name: The Long Haul
courses.blurb: Three floors end to end, and the starting block in the middle of them.

courses.name: Four Quarters
courses.blurb: Two by two, and the crossing is the hard part.
